subject: Private deployment commercial model — usage-aligned discount proposal
messages:
From: Samantha Li <sam.li@healthco.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment pricing ask — baseline and usage discount idea

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're interested in a VPC/on-prem deployment for our regulated workloads and want to align commercial terms to how much inference we actually run. Our key questions:

- Can Redwood offer a model that combines a one-time platform fee + a metered compute/unit charge?
- Are there standard supports tiers for private deployments (SLA, on-call RTO, incident credits)?
- Would you consider a usage-aligned rebate if sustained throughput exceeds X tokens/sec for more than 3 consecutive months?

We need the pricing structure to be friendly to our CAPEX accounting team and are open to a 24-month commit if there's a clear amortization path for the platform fee. I'm looping John (Finance) and procurement.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Director, AI Platforms
HealthCo

On procurement: procurement@healthco.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <sam.li@healthco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing ask — baseline and usage discount idea

Samantha — really helpful context, thank you. Attached are two docs: HealthCo_TermSheet_v2.pdf (commercial layout) and HC_SOW_cost_breakdown.xlsx (line-item tooling + onboarding). High level options below; happy to walk through on a call.

Option A — Fixed entitlement + platform fee- 24-month license covering N dedicated nodes (node-based pricing)- One-time platform fee (AMORTIZABLE) to cover control plane & private console- Optional on-call retainer for 24/7 support

Option B — Metered consumption + tiered support (preferred for bursty workloads)- Lower up-front platform fee, per-token consumption at a blended rate- Support bands: Standard (business hours), Enhanced (24x5 on-call), Platinum (24x7 with named oncall)- Commitment tiers reduce per-token price at volume thresholds

Unique proposal — Throughput Rebate (usage-aligned):
- If sustained average inference throughput > 0.9X of committed tier for 3 consecutive months, apply a retroactive rebate on per-token charges for that period (up to 18% max).
- Rebate is payable as credits against future invoices or one-time refund (we can agree on accounting treatment).

Key clarifications we need from you:
- Expected steady-state tokens/day and peak concurrency- Preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly)
- CAPEX accounting preference for amortization (24 vs 36 months)

Next step: if helpful, we can provide a model with three scenarios (low/med/high consumption) and show net TCO across 24 months. Would you like that before a legal redline session?

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Enterprise Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HealthCo_TermSheet_v2.pdf (term sheet), HC_SOW_cost_breakdown.xlsx (SOW + cost model)
From: John Peters <john.peters@healthco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Samantha Li <sam.li@healthco.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing ask — baseline and usage discount idea

Rafael, Samantha — thanks. A few quick finance/procurement clarifications from our side: 

1) Minimum commit we can sign to (for budgeting) — what is your minimum for Option B?
2) Platform fee amortization — can Redwood provide an invoice schedule that lets us capitalize the fee (24 months preferred)?
3) SLA / On-call — is the platinum band backed by Response Time Objectives in the SOW? We need RTOs for P1/P2 incidents and a credits matrix.
4) Spend cap — can you include a soft cap with alerting to prevent runaway spend?

Also: procurement prefers credits over refunds for rebates for easier reconciliation. 

If you can respond to these points and share an updated invoice schedule we can start internal approval.

Regards,
John Peters
VP Finance, HealthCo
procurement@healthco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Pricing framing + support band concern

Rafa — quick internal note before we respond to John:

- I like Option B with the throughput rebate; it gives HealthCo upside and reduces upfront friction.
- Concern: platinum SLA with hard RTOs and a deep credits matrix increases our operational risk. Propose we
  - keep RTOs for P1/P2 but cap credits at 10% of monthly invoice for 24 months
  - offer a named-oncall for early months as part of onboarding (90 days) instead of indefinite Platinum retainer

Comps: propose an introductory commercial concession — 15% off per-token for the first 3 months + onboarding credit (10% of first invoice) in exchange for a 24-month term and a 6-month notice for downgrade.

If you're ok, I can draft the specific clause language we put into the SOW and the invoice schedule.

-Marissa
Head of Commercial Deals
Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: John Peters <john.peters@healthco.com>, Samantha Li <sam.li@healthco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing ask — updated proposal and next steps

John / Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Based on internal alignment we've put together a counter-proposal (attached updated term sheet). Highlights:

- Commercial structure: Metered consumption (Option B) with a $125k platform fee (amortizable over 24 months)
- Initial concession: 15% off per-token for first 3 months + onboarding credit equal to 10% of first invoice
- Throughput Rebate: up to 15% credit (applied as invoice credit) when sustained throughput tiers are exceeded for 3 consecutive months
- SLA: P1 RTO = 60 minutes, P2 RTO = 4 hours. Credits capped at 10% of monthly invoice. Named-oncall for first 90 days included.
- Soft spend cap: we will add automatic alerting at 70/85/95% of your monthly forecast and a hard cap option behind PO approval.

Next actions:
1) I'll push the updated term sheet and SOW to DocuSign (link below) for signature on commercial terms.
2) Legal redline call — propose Tues 10/26 @ 10am PT; please confirm attendees.
3) Finance: Rafael to share invoice schedule suitable for capitalization (we'll issue a 24-month amortization invoice plan).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/EXAMPLE-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

If that aligns, we'll prepare the invoice and updated SOW and loop Legal.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Enterprise Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HealthCo_TermSheet_v2.pdf, HC_SOW_cost_breakdown.xlsx
From: Samantha Li <sam.li@healthco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: John Peters <john.peters@healthco.com>, procurement@healthco.com
Date: 2026-10-20T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing ask — acceptance in principle

Rafael / team — appreciate the quick turn. The counter-proposal looks reasonable and addresses our main concerns. Two small asks before we route to Legal / Procurement:

1) Please send a draft invoice schedule we can pass to Finance (line items separated: platform fee, expected month-by-month consumption estimate, credits).
2) We'll want a short legal redline window (30 min) — Tue 10/26 at 10am PT works for us; please invite our counsel.

We will plan to issue a PO once the DocuSign envelope is ready and legal confirms redlines. Thanks — excited to get started.

Samantha Li
Director, AI Platforms
HealthCo
